title: Corrected (re-queued) rows hide the attempt-log timeline and export — AC1's correction event is suppressed for every corrected row
detail: AC1: a started row's timeline must cover "every send, form-opened, correction, takeover, substitution, and terminal event." correct_reference_call.sql re-queues corrected rows to status 'queued' while stamping corrected_at; the payload carries those entries, but the gate hides the whole log. Timeline and export vanish until the sweep re-fires.
recommended_fix: Render the log block whenever attempt_log is non-empty (drop the Queued suppression except for genuinely never-started rows), or add a corrected-row exception, keeping the export affordance for corrected rows.

title: Unused `type ReferenceCallStatus` import survives the import-block rewrite in this diff
detail: This diff rewrites the shared/reference_call import block (adding AttemptLogEntry) but keeps ReferenceCallStatus, which no code in the module annotates — `gleam check` warns. The rework claimed import hygiene elsewhere (removed unused gleam/result) but left this one.
recommended_fix: Remove `type ReferenceCallStatus` from the shared/reference_call import list in reference_panel.gleam.
